kv6.9:1.3: Rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati
kv6.9:2.3: Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca cakkhundriyañ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti?
kv6.9:3.1: Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca cakkhundriyañ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti?
kv6.9:3.3: "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca cakkhundriyañ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti."
kv6.9:3.6: "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti."
kv6.9:3.9: Hañci "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti,"
kv6.9:3.10: atth' eva suttanto, no vata re vattabbe
kv6.9:3.11: "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca cakkhundriyañ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti." 6.
kv6.9:4.4: Nanu passati cakkhuṃ sotaṃ ghānaṃ jivhaṃ kāyan ti?
kv6.9:4.6: Hañci passati cakkhuṃ sotaṃ ghānaṃ jivhaṃ kāyaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe
